chapters.title: Welcome to the Vault: Cryptography Foundations 🔑
chapters.description: Unlock the secret world of hidden messages! Learn what cryptography is, why it rules the digital age, and meet the key players: plaintext, ciphertext, and keys.

chapters.title: Secret Keys: Symmetric Cryptography 🔐
chapters.description: Dive into symmetric encryption where both sides share a secret key. Explore classic ciphers like Caesar and Vigenère, and meet the modern king: AES.

chapters.title: Math Magic: Asymmetric Cryptography 🔮
chapters.description: Discover the magic of public and private keys. Unravel RSA, Diffie‑Hellman key exchange, and the elegance of elliptic curves.

chapters.title: Digital Fingerprints: Hash Functions 🖐️
chapters.description: Meet the one‑way functions that create digital fingerprints. Understand SHA‑256, integrity checks, and why hashing is not encryption.

chapters.title: Signing on the Dotted Line: Digital Signatures ✍️
chapters.description: How can you trust a digital document? Learn digital signatures, certificates, and the Public Key Infrastructure that keeps the internet trustworthy.

chapters.title: Real‑World Crypto: SSL/TLS & HTTPS 🌐
chapters.description: The padlock in your browser isn't magic. Walk through TLS handshakes, certificate chains, and how every secure website protects your data.

chapters.title: Encode This: Encoding vs Encryption 💾
chapters.description: Base64, Hex, URL‑encoding... They look secret but they're not! Learn the crucial difference between encoding (reversible, no key) and true encryption.

chapters.title: Cracking the Code: Cryptanalysis 101 🔍
chapters.description: Put on your hacker hat. Explore frequency analysis, brute‑force attacks, and side‑channel leaks. Know the enemy to build stronger defences.

chapters.title: Password Power: Hashing & Salting 🧂
chapters.description: Your passwords aren't stored in plain text (we hope!). Learn how salts, peppers, and bcrypt keep credentials safe from rainbow tables.

chapters.title: Blockchain Basics: Cryptography in Crypto 🔗
chapters.description: What makes Bitcoin tick? Understand hash chaining, Merkle trees, proof‑of‑work, and how cryptography creates trust without a middleman.

chapters.title: Secret Sharing & Zero‑Knowledge 🤫
chapters.description: Split a secret so no single person holds the whole key. Then discover zero‑knowledge proofs – proving you know something without revealing it!

chapters.title: Future Proof: Post‑Quantum Cryptography ⚛️
chapters.description: Quantum computers could break today’s crypto. Meet lattice‑based algorithms, code‑based schemes, and the race to secure tomorrow.
